scope: New reporting v3 implementation and fixture checks; old frozen reporting sources and prior overview outputs are preserved.

covered_invariants: Comparison IDs use configuration distance and ID ties, not observed scores; before/after deltas require two completed results.
A missing or mismatching trial receipt does not become a successful completed result.
Initial root README migration requires the previous v2 snapshot hash; later output ownership protects manual changes.
Public capture excludes learned model JSON, predictions, ZIPs, runtime state, logs and raw selection records.
Private artifact hashes are verified without adding those artifact bytes to public evidence.
Embedded learned coefficients and model payloads in public JSON are rejected.
Snapshot scope, hashes, age, timezone and CSV part sequence are checked.
The requested snapshot flag distinguishes a recovered old pending commit from a commit containing the requested current snapshot.

separate_readonly_workspace_review.evidence_source: Runtime reviewer independently ran the real-workspace read-only integration check and reported its results before this record was written.
separate_readonly_workspace_review.new_trial_rows_reason: New protocol/configuration preparation had not yet completed at the time of the read-only integration check.

limitations: No completed novel trial existed during the real-workspace integration check; actual novel result capture still needs verification after preparation and execution.
This record does not certify candidate quality, candidate ZIP validation, official score improvement or successful GitHub publication.
Production README generation and publication remain gated on the reviewed frozen reporting contract and the prepared campaign.
